decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressively using Rakdos creatures and removal spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to combine efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser with powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure on the battlefield. Additionally, the deck includes finishers like Archfiend of the Dross to close out games quickly.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to flood the board with efficient creatures like Resplendent Angel, Righteous Valkyrie, and Skyclave Apparition, while using cards like Collected Company and Kayla's Reconstruction to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp into its powerful threats quickly. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on casting cheap spells and using card draw to enable the powerful Arclight Phoenix to return from the graveyard. Utilizing efficient removal like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse, along with card selection spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand, allows the deck to quickly put pressure on the opponent. Picklock Prankster helps to enable the Phoenix's return, while cards like Ledger Shredder and Hall of Storm Giants provide additional options for disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and evasive threats.

This Jund aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of sacrifice synergies and aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven, the deck can constantly generate value and damage while disrupting the opponent's board. Additionally, the inclusion of Ygra, Eater of All and Scavenger's Talent provide additional ways to interact with the opponent's resources. The deck's streamlined focus on aggressive plays and resource disruption makes it a potent force in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick, aggressive creature plays supported by burn spells and combat tricks to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while utilizing cards like Reckless Impulse and Showdown of the Skalds to maintain card advantage and keep up the pressure. The deck also includes removal spells like Portable Hole and Chained to the Rocks to deal with threats from the opponent and keep the way clear for attacking.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Favored Hoplite to quickly build up a strong board presence. The deck also includes a variety of combat tricks and protection spells like Gods Willing and Defiant Strike to maintain pressure on the opponent while protecting its own creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional versatility and potential for explosive plays, while the land base ensures consistent mana production for a smooth curve of threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green cards with high devotion to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy. The deck includes cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns to quickly build up a strong board presence, supported by mana accelerators like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival provide card advantage and help maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of powerful creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to maintain early pressure with low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, using spells such as Titan's Strength and Reckless Rage to remove blockers and deal additional damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. By combining fast creatures, burn spells, and a consistent mana base, this deck aims to close out games swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Bishop of Wings, Giada, Font of Hope, and Llanowar Elves. Collected Company helps dig for more threats while providing a potential instant-speed board presence. Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel act as the top end of the curve, rewarding players for gaining life and going wide with tokens. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and anthem effects, backed up by interaction from Skyclave Apparition and Kayla's Reconstruction.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. The key concept revolves around playing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, while utilizing burn spells like Fatal Push and Monstrous Rage to clear the way for attacks. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the goal is to maintain a fast pace and apply pressure to the opponent to secure a swift victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, backed up by spells like Titan's Strength and Fatal Push to maintain board control. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides extra value and flexibility. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, creature-heavy strategy while utilizing powerful combat tricks and removal spells to push through for victory. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that pressure to secure a win.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, players can ensure a consistent mana base while still maintaining a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck includes cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword to apply early pressure, supported by burn spells like Ancestral Anger and Titan's Strength. By playing aggressively and efficiently using creature abilities and burn spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to manipulate the opponent's resources through counter spells, removal, and card draw, while establishing a strong land base to support its strategy. The deck aims to control the game tempo and maintain board presence with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It also utilizes bounce spells and disruptive cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from developing their board. Overall, the deck's key concept is to control the game through card advantage and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing evasive Spirit creatures and disruptive spells to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent. By playing cheap, efficient creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller, while also having access to counter spells and removal like Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to outpace opponents by maintaining control of the board and applying pressure through aggressive attacks. The inclusion of cards like No More Lies and Portable Hole also allows for flexibility in dealing with a variety of threats, ultimately leading to a fast and efficient victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to constantly tutor for creatures with a variety of powerful abilities. By using Fires of Invention to cast spells for free, the deck can quickly establish control over the board and overwhelm opponents with a wide range of threats. The deck also utilizes Leyline Binding and Chained to the Rocks to handle opposing threats, while Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by blinking creatures and permanents for extra triggers. With a diverse creature lineup and powerful enchantments, this deck aims to out-value and out-control opponents in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 setting.

The key concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly build a wide board presence with efficient creatures like Bishop of Wings, Giada, and Righteous Valkyrie, while also utilizing cards like Collected Company to fill the battlefield with more threats. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and maintain a steady stream of aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Skyclave Apparition helps in removing opposing threats and clearing the way for your own creatures to attack without hindrance. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to dominate the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.
